comparison.objective: Fit and clamp a hose on a valve barb, versus adjust and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counterholding, forceful hose insertion, clamp sliding, and lift verification; only generic stabilization overlaps.
comparison.success_condition: Hose must cover at least 2 cm, clamp cover the barb, and assembly survive a lift; force and slip tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant interference fitting and clamp placement rather than tool-driven calibration of dynamic response.
